environment.note: Local development PostgreSQL 16, not the CI/production PostgreSQL 17 service; directional evidence only, per the decision proposal's own framing (SPIKE-03 is a 'short insert/index benchmark to confirm', not a capacity or production benchmark).

workload.insert_shape: 1,000-row batched INSERTs into an otherwise-empty UNLOGGED table, then VACUUM (ANALYZE)

results.candidate: text (UUIDv4-shaped, uncorrelated with insert order — today's scheme)

summary.conclusion: UUIDv7 confirms the expected B-tree locality benefit over an uncorrelated text/UUIDv4 key at this row count: roughly 44% smaller primary-key index and a consistently equal-or-faster batched insert. This confirms D7's premise; it does not by itself size the cost of the migration (see the migration plan in this directory).
